name: s2-iron-double
goal: @all Double our iron plate production (now about {iron} per minute, so the target is 2x that) by adding electric mining drills on iron ore and belt-fed furnace columns. Report in chat when the new lines run.

score.name: iron_per_min

score.lua: local k=0 for _,e in pairs(machines('iron-plate')) do if e.status==defines.entity_status.working then k=k+1 end end return k
